The Qubrid AI Fine-Tuning API enables developers and enterprises to customize open-source AI models using their own data. The API provides endpoints for uploading training datasets in CSV format, configuring fine-tuning parameters such as epochs, learning rate, max steps, and validation split, launching training jobs on GPU infrastructure, and retrieving fine-tuned model artifacts. Qubrid supports both no-code and API-driven fine-tuning workflows for text generation and code generation models, making it accessible to teams with varying levels of ML expertise.
